title: Solution Engineer - Chennai
description: Join Our Journey at VuNet VuNet is a pioneer in Business Journey Observability , leveraging Big Data and Machine Learning to transform digital experiences across the financial services. Our deep-tech platform provides end-to-end visibility into customer journeys — empowering proactive issue resolution, operational resilience, and superior user satisfaction. If you’ve ever used instant payment systems like UPI, chances are you’ve already experienced the power of our platform — we monitor over 28 billion digital transactions monthly (that’s equal to watching 3 years of tik-tok videos) , touching 300 million users with leading banks and financial institutions . VuNet is Series B funded, part of NASSCOM DeepTech Club, awarded NASSCOM’s AI Gamechanger, recognized in Forbes DGEMS 200 and by several global analysts including Gartner, Omdia. We’re building a new category of observability purpose-built for complex digital journeys — across payments, lending, core banking and more — already powering some of the largest banks in India and MEA. The ideal candidate will leverage our platform to deliver valuable insights that help optimize business processes and infrastructure. They will play a key role in streamlining day-to-day operations, maximizing efficiency, and ensuring the best possible Return on Investment (ROI) for our customers. Are you excited to be a part of VuNet's trailblazing team? Create detailed designs, solutions and validate with internal engineering and peer teams. Establish a good network of relationships with both internal and external customers. Understand the customers’ application architecture and transaction level workflow to identify critical touch points and necessary metrics to be monitored and analysed to provide detailed insights. Analytics and analysis on data and provide business insights and recommendations Constantly stay ahead in communicating the latest progress/status with customers. Manage planning and execution of platform implementation at customer sites. Work with the product team in developing new features, identifying platform bugs, solution gaps etc Interest and aptitude in learning new technologies- Big Data, no SQL databases, Elastic Search, Mongo DB, DevOps What You Bring At least 3+years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Observability or APM. Experience in working with large scale IT infra, including applications, transactions, databases, network. Experience in working with monitoring tools and automation tools. Hands-on experience in scripting. Knowledge/Experience in the following technologies will be added plus. Observability platforms, Elastic search, MongoDB, Big Data, SQL databases, ELK stack, REST APIs, web services, JMX, Python/Bash Scripting). Good to Have CKA certification - Certified Kubernetes Administrator What We Offer Life at VuNet: Building the Future Together At VuNet, we’re building a world-class observability platform, proudly Made in India — and we're just getting started. We’re a team of passionate problem-solvers who love tackling complex challenges. We learn fast, adapt quickly, and stay curious — especially when it comes to exploring and staying ahead of the curve with emerging technologies like Gen AI . More than just a tech company, VuNet is a place where collaboration, learning, and innovation are part of everyday life. We believe in working together, taking ownership, and growing as a team. If you’re looking to work on cutting-edge technology, make a real impact, and grow with a supportive team — you’ll feel right at home at VuNet . Know More and Follow us on Benefits For You Health insurance coverage for you, your parents, and dependents. Mental wellness and 1:1 counselling support. A learning culture that promotes growth, innovation, and ownership. Transparent, Inclusive, and high-trust workplace culture. New Gen AI and integrated Technology workspace. Supportive career development programs to expand your skills and enhance expertise with various training programs.

title: Data Engineer
description: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team. In this role, you will assist in designing, building, maintaining, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, data warehouses, and analytics infrastructure. You will work closely with senior data engineers, data scientists, software developers, and business stakeholders to transform raw data into structured, actionable data assets for reporting, advanced analytics, and operational systems. Key Responsibilities 1. Data Pipeline Development & Maintenance (ETL / ELT) Assist in developing, testing, and maintaining automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest structured and unstructured data from diverse sources (APIs, relational databases, streaming services, flat files). Monitor existing data pipelines, troubleshoot data ingestion failures, and implement bug fixes or performance enhancements. Implement data transformation, cleansing, and validation routines to maintain high data quality and consistency. 2. Data Modeling & Storage Support the design and maintenance of relational schemas, dimensional models (star and snowflake schemas), and data lake storage structures. Write and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and views to extract and aggregate data efficiently. Assist in partitioning, indexing, and organizing datasets for optimal query performance. 3. Data Quality & Governance Collaborate with senior engineers to implement data validation checks, monitoring alerts, and data reconciliation processes. Follow enterprise data governance, privacy, and security policies (e.g., role-based access control, encryption, data masking). Document data lineage, metadata definitions, schema changes, and technical architecture. 4. Collaboration & CI/CD Practices Participate in agile/scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings. Use version control systems (Git) for code management and follow continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices. Collaborate with QA teams and business analysts to conduct integration and user acceptance testing (UAT). Qualifications & Skills Required Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience/bootcamp certification). Experience: 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience in data engineering, data analytics, software development, or related academic/internship projects. Key Skills & Technologies Programming Languages Python, SQL (mandatory); familiarity with Java, Scala, or Bash scripting is a plus. Relational Databases & SQL PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server, or Oracle. Proficient in joins, window functions, indexing, and aggregations. Data Warehousing & Lakes Familiarity with platforms such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, Databricks, or cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, GCS). Data Processing Frameworks Basic understanding of Apache Spark, PySpark, Pandas, or Polars. Workflow Orchestration Exposure to tools like Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or cron-based job scheduling. Version Control & DevOps Git/GitHub/GitLab, basic containerization (Docker), and exposure to CI/CD pipelines. Soft Skills & Competencies Problem Solving: Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting mindset with attention to detail. Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Eagerness to Learn: Self-starter with a proactive attitude toward learning modern data architectures, cloud technologies, and best practices. Teamwork: Strong collaborative skills and ability to thrive in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications Cloud certification (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Data Analytics, Azure Data Fundamentals DP-900 / DP-203, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer). Familiarity with modern data stack tools such as dbt (data build tool) , Kafka, or Delta Lake. Understanding of basic DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts (e.g., Terraform, Kubernetes). Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker). description: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. Job Overview We are seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Data Platform Engineer to design, build and manage complex, high-performance enterprise data services supporting data integration, reconciliation, data controls, data quality and operational intelligence. The role combines strong software engineering expertise with distributed data processing, cloud-native architecture and modern lakehouse technologies. The successful candidate will develop reusable, scalable and resilient data services supporting high-volume batch and real-time processing across enterprise applications. Key Responsibilities:- Enterprise Data Services Engineering: Architect, develop and maintain complex, reusable data services for data ingestion, transformation, standardisation, validation, reconciliation and data processing using Scala, Spark, Python and Java. Data Integration & Processing: Build scalable integration frameworks supporting files, databases, APIs, Kafka, CDC and enterprise messaging, including batch, near-real-time and streaming ingestion. Reconciliation & Matching Engines: Develop high-performance reconciliation services supporting complex matching rules, multi-pass matching, tolerance handling, one-to-one and many-to-many matching, balance proofing and exception generation. Data Controls & Integrity: Engineer reusable control frameworks for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, record counts, control totals, source-to-target validation, auditability, data lineage, replay and recovery. Data Quality Engineering: Develop configurable data quality services supporting schema validation, business rules, profiling, anomaly detection, data quality scoring, exception handling and automated remediation. Databricks & Lakehouse Engineering: Build and optimise distributed processing workloads using Databricks, Apache Spark, S3, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and Lakeflow orchestration. Streaming & Event-Driven Services: Develop Kafka/MSK-based event-processing services, CDC integration, stateful streaming, checkpointing, deduplication and reliable event delivery. Software & API Development: Design and develop REST APIs, microservices, metadata-driven processing frameworks, configuration services and reusable libraries using Scala, Java/Spring Boot and Python. AI & Intelligent Data Services: Integrate AI/ML capabilities for intelligent matching, anomaly detection, data quality remediation, metadata discovery and AI-assisted data processing. Cloud Engineering, DevOps & Reliability: Implement AWS infrastructure, Terraform, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, performance optimisation, FinOps, production support and disaster recovery. Essential Technical Skills:- Software Engineering: Strong hands-on Scala, Java or Python development, object-oriented design, concurrency, distributed systems and software design patterns. Distributed Processing: Apache Spark, Scala Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming and performance tuning. Cloud & Lakehouse: AWS, Databricks, S3, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog. Data Integration: Kafka/MSK, CDC, REST APIs, JDBC, file processing and enterprise messaging. Data Services: Data transformation, reconciliation, rule engines, data validation, data controls, data quality and exception processing. Application Development: Microservices, REST APIs, Spring Boot/FastAPI, metadata-driven frameworks and service integration. Data Engineering: SQL, data modelling, schema evolution, partitioning, incremental processing and data optimisation. DevOps & SRE: Terraform, Docker, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry and production troubleshooting. Desirable Skills:- Experience developing enterprise reconciliation or financial data processing platforms. Real-time matching, balance proofing and stateful stream processing. AI/ML, MLflow, vector search, RAG and agentic AI integration. MongoDB Atlas, PostgreSQL/Aurora and enterprise workflow integration. Financial services data governance, regulatory controls and operational resilience. Experience 8+ years of hands-on software development and data platform engineering. Proven experience building complex, high-throughput distributed data services. Strong development experience with Scala/Spark and cloud-native architectures. Experience designing reusable frameworks rather than only implementing ETL pipelines. Demonstrated ownership of production systems, performance, reliability and scalability. Experience delivering enterprise-scale platforms within regulated environments preferred. Expected Outcomes:- Scalable, reusable enterprise data services. High-performance batch and streaming reconciliation processing. Automated, auditable data quality and control frameworks. Reliable and cost-efficient Databricks/AWS workloads. Production-ready services with strong observability, resilience and automated recovery. Accelerated onboarding of new data sources and business use cases through configurable, self-service capabilities. description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role As a Data Analyst at Kyndryl, you will unlock the power of data to drive strategic decisions and shape the future of our business. You will harness your expertise in data analysis, business fundamentals, statistics, and communication to uncover valuable insights and transform raw data into meaningful visualizations and compelling stories that influence real-world outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work with vast and complex datasets, helping customers better understand their environments through data-driven insights. By identifying trends, patterns, and opportunities within the data, you will enable smarter decision-making and support business transformation initiatives across the organization. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy, and collaboration needed to help organizations turn data into one of their most valuable assets. What You Will Do Collect, organize, structure, and clean data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis. Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, root causes, anomalies, and opportunities for business improvement. Develop insightful reports, dashboards, visualizations, and data-driven recommendations for business stakeholders. Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to understand business objectives, project requirements, and success criteria. Translate complex business problems into analytical approaches and actionable solutions. Leverage statistical methods, business intelligence tools, and analytical techniques to generate meaningful insights. Communicate findings effectively through storytelling, presentations, and visualizations that influence business decisions. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying data quality issues, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for optimization. Partner with technical and business teams to ensure data is properly prepared and aligned with organizational goals. Drive data-informed decision-making by delivering accurate, timely, and actionable analysis. If you have a passion for analytics, problem-solving, and transforming data into business value, this is the position for you. You will work with talented professionals and collaborate on innovative projects that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Data Analyst, you will work closely with business leaders, customers, data professionals, and technology teams to solve complex challenges through data. Whether you aspire to become a Data Scientist, Business Intelligence Specialist, Analytics Consultant, Data Engineer, or Data Architect, Kyndryl provides the opportunities, mentorship, and resources to help accelerate your career growth. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, ETL Development, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence environments. Hands-on experience supporting and maintaining ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data integration workflows. Strong experience with Databricks, including Delta Live Tables (DLT), Databricks SQL, and Python. Working knowledge of Power BI data modelling, including relationships, measures, DAX, and Power Query. Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, aggregations, data transformation, and query optimization. Experience validating and troubleshooting data feeds, identifying data quality issues, and implementing corrective actions. Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and data lifecycle management. Experience handling multiple file formats, including CSV, TXT, Excel, JSON, and other structured data sources. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Experience supporting data quality monitoring, issue investigation, root cause analysis, and escalation processes. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience developing and maintaining Power BI datasets, semantic models, and reporting solutions. Experience contributing to Silver and Gold layer modelling within Databricks or modern Lakehouse architectures. Knowledge of data governance, master data management, and data quality best practices. Experience using Python for data transformation, automation, and data quality validation. Working knowledge of Azure Data Platform services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Synapse Analytics. Experience supporting financial, operational, sales, or customer analytics reporting environments. Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, data dictionaries, business rules, and process documentation. Familiarity with Power BI DAX optimization, Power Query transformations, and semantic model performance tuning. Experience working within Agile delivery teams and collaborating with Business Intelligence Managers, Data Engineers, and Analytics teams. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. title: Generative AI Developer - Hyd/Bang/Chennai
description: Dear candidate, Please find the JD for the AI Developer role below, let me know if you have any questions. Role Summary We are looking for an AI Developer to design, build, and run agentic AI systems: software agents that plan, call tools, use company data, and complete multi-step tasks with controlled human oversight. You will work with several model providers and model sizes, choosing and routing between them for quality, speed, cost, and data-handling needs, ensuring no single model or vendor becomes a point of failure. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will write production code, build evaluation harnesses, and take agents from prototype to a monitored, secure, and supportable service. Key Responsibilities Agent design and build • Design and build agents and multi-agent workflows that plan, use tools, keep state, and complete multi-step business tasks. • Choose the right pattern for each problem (single agent, workflow with fixed steps, supervisor and worker agents, human-in-the-loop approval) and explain the trade-offs. • Write and maintain prompts, system instructions, tool definitions, and structured output schemas as versioned code. • Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and memory components, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid search, and citation of sources. Multi-model strategy and orchestration • Work with several model families and providers (for example Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, and open-weight models such as Llama or Mistral) through hosted APIs, cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI), and self-hosted inference. • Build a model abstraction and routing layer that selects models by task type, quality, latency, cost, context length, and data-residency rules, with fallbacks when a provider fails or rate-limits. • Benchmark models on our own tasks and data, record the results, and re-evaluate when new models or versions are released. • Manage cost and latency through caching, batching, prompt compression, smaller models for simple steps, and token budgets. Tools and integrations • Connect agents to enterprise systems through REST and SOAP APIs, databases, message queues, files, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool standards. • Design tools with clear contracts, least-privilege access, input validation, idempotency, and safe handling of errors and retries. • Build integrations for document processing, search, email and messaging, workflow engines, and line-of-business applications such as claims, policy, and finance systems. Evaluation and quality • Build evaluation suites with golden datasets, automated checks, model-graded and human review, and regression tests that run on every change to prompts, tools, or models. • Measure task success, accuracy, groundedness, tool-call correctness, latency, and cost, and report them to stakeholders. • Run red-team and adversarial tests, including prompt injection, data leakage, and tool misuse. Safety, security, and governance • Apply guardrails: input and output filtering, permission checks before actions, approval steps for high-impact actions, and audit logs of every agent decision and tool call. • Protect personal and health data (PII and PHI) through masking, access control, encryption, retention rules, and region-appropriate hosting, in line with applicable regulations (for example data-privacy law and sector rules such as IRDAI). • Document model choices, known limitations, and risks, and support internal AI governance and model risk reviews. Operations and collaboration • Deploy agents through CI/CD pipelines to cloud or container platforms, with tracing, monitoring, alerting, usage and cost dashboards, and incident runbooks. • Provide L2/L3 support for agent incidents and carry out root-cause analysis, including bad outputs, tool failures, and model regressions. • Work with business owners, product managers, security, data, and integration teams to scope use cases, define success metrics, and plan rollout. • Review code and designs, mentor developers new to LLM engineering, and keep technical documentation and an internal catalog of agents, tools, and approved models.
